summary: Fixed 4 review issues: (1) runsc fallback to plain Docker on DockerException; (2) made code testable via DI for future integration tests; (3) DockerSandbox accepts optional docker_client parameter, tests inject mock at boundary instead of patching docker.DockerClient; (4) proxy URLs moved to configurable SandboxConfig fields (http_proxy, https_proxy, no_proxy) with defaults.
